Actual source and git history identify introducing commit 733256ede964bc99e46f8ce7faffb690df0c6a49, owned by your phase sase-1m3.7.1.2. It predates the release-portability epic; not caused by its openat fix. This deterministic filesystem-dependent fixture blocks core 0.42.0 and the sase 0.18.0 release. Preserve non-UTF8 Git-tree coverage while making fixture construction independent of filesystem filename restrictions (for example, construct the Git index/tree using raw-byte NUL-delimited records rather than writing that path to disk). Do not skip or weaken the required assertion. Full CI log: file:explicit:cf44a5d9c96251754e7b7e5f; https://github.com/sase-org/sase-core/actions/runs/39089637894/job/117563429625. sase_new_task all-status searches, last-week task sweep, and active-epic review found no duplicate task; routed here as the causal active epic instead of creating a task or another release repair epic.
